title: Connection Component
description: Describes a REST API connection — how to talk to a system and fetch or push data.

response_type.description: Expected response body format. Default: json. Use 'binary' for file downloads.

body_type.description: Request body format. Default: json. Use 'binary' for raw file upload, 'multipart' for form-data upload.

binary_info.description: Required when body_type is 'binary' or 'multipart'. Configures binary transfer.

source_bytes.description: Placeholder or fn call resolving to a Buffer in shared space.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file being sent. May be a {{placeholder}}.

file_name.description: Filename to declare. May be a {{placeholder}}. Used in multipart Content-Disposition.

file_field.description: multipart only: the form field name for the file part. Default: 'file'.

fields.description: multipart only: metadata fields to prepend before the file part. Object or {{placeholder}} resolving to an object.

idempotency_key.description: Dot-path into response metadata (ctx.output.meta) whose value uniquely identifies this binary content. Used by receiveAttachment to skip re-processing already-seen files.

auth.description: Authentication block. Resolved by the engine before each request.
